text:
Margo: Quick one -- flying to Tokyo next week, any must-eat spots near Shibuya or Shinjuku? Prefer casual izakaya or late ramen.
Ben: For Shibuya, try Ichiran for solo ramen vibes, but long lines. For izakaya, Uoshin has great small plates.
Aisha: If you want authentic yakitori, head to Omoide Yokocho in Shinjuku -- tiny stalls, loud & fun. Also Golden Gai for drinks.
Tom: Night owls: Ichiba market stalls near Shinjuku are open late. For curry, CoCo Ichibanya is everywhere but not the coolest.
Margo: Budget tip? cheap breakfast near Shibuya station?
Aisha: Mister Donut or convenience store onigiri are lifesavers. Also kissaten cafes for old-school coffee.
Ben: If you're ok with a short train, Nakameguro has great bakeries for breakfast.
Margo: Any sushi that's good late at night? arriving ~10pm.
Tom: Try sushi bars around Ebisu or the conveyor spots -- not Michelin but tasty and late.
Aisha: For something special, Sushizanmai is open 24/7 in some locations.
Margo: Amazing, thanks. Switching gears -- office snack run: who wants to try a new bakery near the SF office at lunch? thinking 12:30. @Ben @Aisha
Ben: I'm in :white_check_mark:
Aisha: Maybe, will know by 12:15.
Tom: If bakery, also grab some savory pastries at Red Oven Bakery on 4th.
Margo: Also, is there a quick place for vegetarian bento near Market St?
Ben: Lotus Bowl does veggie bento boxes. Greens & Grain on 5th also has good bowls.

Margo: I'll post the plan in calendar and DM anyone who RSVPs. Thanks all -- will share Tokyo notes when I return.
